mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Mischievous Mystic: "Flying. Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 blue
# Faerie creature token with flying."
# M21 Jolrael's verified "second card each turn" trigger; the token as Roost of Drakes' flying Drake.
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CardDrawnEvent(
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
        ordinal=2,
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Faerie',
            type_line='Creature — Faerie',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Faerie',),
            power=QConst(value=1),
            toughness=QConst(value=1),
            keywords=(Keyword.FLYING,),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('U',),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 1/1 blue Faerie creature token with flying.

mapping.notes: Jolrael's verified 'second card each turn' trigger; a 1/1 blue flying Faerie (Faebloom Trick's TokenSpec). Flying compiled. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: mischievous_mystic_only_your_second_draw.
